title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
- Location: Bath
- Job Type: Part-time (22.5 hours per week)
- Salary: £30,000 p.a. pro rata

We are seeking an Accounts Assistant to join our family run business. This role is crucial in supporting the Financial Controller with a range of financial tasks including Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities and general financial administration. This position is ideal for someone who is organised, reliable, and proactive, and thrives in a small, dynamic team environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Accounts Payable (AP): Process supplier invoices with accurate coding and approval, maintain the AP ledger, ensure timely payment runs, and reconcile supplier statements.
- Accounts Receivable (AR): Assist in checking and approving tenant invoices, be the first point of contact for credit control, maintain the AR ledger, and update tenant accounts.
- Banking & Reconciliation: Perform daily bank reconciliations, post financial entries, and manage tenant deposit accounts.
- Service Charge & Property Management Support: Assist in the reconciliations of service charge budgets, maintain property-related financial records, and liaise with property managers, suppliers, and tenants regarding finance-related queries.
- Month-End & Reporting: Prepare control account reconciliations, assist with month-end processes, and prepare reports for management and stakeholders.
- General Finance Administration: Maintain digital filing systems, assist with finance-related tasks and projects, and support the Financial Controller with additional duties.
- General Office Tasks: Assist with general office administration including managing staff refreshments, handling post, and answering calls.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant role.
- Strong understanding of Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable processes.
- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
- Excellent communication skills.

Desirable:
- Experience in property management or real estate finance.
- Knowledge of service charge accounting.
- Familiarity with property management or accounting software (e.g., Xero, ApprovalMax, Re-Leased).

Personal Attributes:
- Proactive and organised, comfortable with varied tasks.
- Reliable and trustworthy with strong ownership of duties.
- Inquisitive nature, actively seeking improvement opportunities.
- Collaborative with a "can-do" attitude.

Benefits:
- Competitive pro rata salary.
- Flexible working hours across 3-5 days.
- Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.
- Involvement in varied and impactful financial tasks.

To apply for the Accounts Assistant position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.

title: Audit & Accounts Assistant
description:
Audit & Accounts Assistant

Bath, Somerset
£27,000 - £30,000 Full Time Permanent
37.5 Hours Per Week
ACA / ACCA Study Support Available

Join One of Bath's Largest Independent Accountancy Practices

Are you looking to develop your career within audit while gaining exposure to a varied and interesting client base? Due to continued growth and expansion, one of Bath's largest and most respected independent accountancy practices is looking to recruit an Audit & Accounts Assistant to join its thriving team.

This is a newly created position, offering an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual who is looking to build on their existing practice experience and progress their career within a supportive, forward-thinking firm.

The successful candidate will join a collaborative team with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality audit, accountancy, tax and advisory services to a broad range of owner-managed businesses, charities and growing organisations across the South West.

The Opportunity

This role has a strong audit focus, making it ideal for someone who enjoys client interaction, analytical work and gaining hands-on experience across a variety of audit assignments.

Working alongside experienced managers and partners, you will play an important role in the delivery of audit engagements while continuing to develop your technical skills and professional knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with and leading sections of audit assignments for a varied client portfolio
- Planning audit fieldwork and preparing audit documentation
- Conducting audit testing and analytical review procedures
- Preparing audit files and supporting working papers
- Liaising directly with clients and maintaining strong professional relationships
- Attending client sites as part of audit assignments
- Assisting with the preparation of statutory accounts
- Preparing financial statements and supporting schedules
- Working closely with managers and senior team members on larger assignments
- Ensuring work is completed accurately and within required deadlines
- Keeping up to date with accounting and auditing standards

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice (1-2 years)
- Exposure to audit assignments
- AAT, ACA/ACCA part qualification or wants to study/qualify
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- A proactive and positive approach to work
- A genuine desire to build a long-term career within audit and accountancy

This firm is committed to developing its people and offers full support for those wishing to study towards ACA or ACCA qualifications.

Salary & Benefits
- £27,000 - £30,000 salary
- Annual salary review
- Flexible working arrangements
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Your birthday off every year
- 37.5-hour full-time working week
- Personal pension scheme
- Life Assurance (4x annual salary)
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing benefits
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Full ACA/ACCA study support
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Friendly and supportive team culture
- Genuine long-term progression opportunities within a growing firm

Apply Now

If you're looking to join one of Bath's leading independent accountancy practices and take the next step in your audit career, this newly created opportunity offers the ideal combination of professional development, study support, and long-term progression.
